are those of a team that hasn't played.

info.description: Everything the Bracket frontend does, it does through this API.
info.summary: API of the Ctrl-Alt-GG fork of Bracket, an open source tournament system.
info.title: Bracket API

post.description:
Ends the session: its cookie is removed from this browser, and its tokens stop working, also
for anyone who copied one.

get.description: Every player by name. The teams they are in come with the teams.

delete.description: Delete the player, who leaves their teams and the lineups of every tournament.

get.description: Every team by name, with its roster and the tournaments it takes part in.

delete.description: Delete a team that takes part in no tournament.

put.description:
Rename the team and replace its roster. The lineups of its open tournaments follow the roster,
and their schedules make room for what the new players play elsewhere.

get.description: Anyone can see a team's logo: the Details pages of its tournaments show it.

The tournaments that everyone may see, and for an organizer also those they run, with whether
the one who asks can manage each.

With `endpoint_name`, only the tournament whose Details link that is.

delete.description: Delete the tournament with everything in it. Its teams and players stay.

get.description: Whether whoever asks can manage the tournament, or only follow it.

post.description:
Archive the tournament, which keeps its lineups as they are, or reopen it. A reopened
tournament's lineups follow its teams' rosters again.

Move every round that hasn't been played yet, and everything after it, for an event that
runs late. A negative number of minutes moves them earlier.

get.description:
Everything the Details pages of a tournament show, in one answer: the tournament, its stages
without draft rounds, players, teams, rankings and standings.

It can be a few seconds old.

Get the teams that take the slots of the next stage once it is activated.

A slot that can't be decided yet is left out: its source ranks fewer teams than the position
the slot takes. `tied_team` names a team that is level on every criterion with the one that
gets the slot, which only seeding put behind it.
Who runs the tournament: its owner, and the accounts the owner added to help.

post.description: Let another account help run the tournament, so that organizers don't share a login.

delete.description: Remove an organizer from the tournament. The owner removes others; anyone can leave.

put.description:
Hand the tournament over to another of its organizers, for an owner who leaves the organizing
team. The previous owner stays on as an organizer.

get.description: The tournament's lineup: its players, the teams they play for, and their results.

schema.title: Offset

post.description:
Create the next round of a Swiss stage item as a draft in which every active team is paired.

Only organizers see the draft. Its pairings can be changed by adding and deleting matches, and
it is published by updating the round with `is_draft` set to false.

put.description:
Rename a round, or publish or withdraw a draft. Only Swiss rounds can be drafts: the rounds of
the other formats are published with their stage item, and a withdrawn one couldn't be
published again.

post.description: Replace a Swiss draft in one transaction, retaining it if any replacement fails.

Plan the schedule again. Every match starts with its round, unless its teams or their players
play a match of another tournament then; it waits until they are free.

delete.description:
Delete a stage item with its rounds and matches.

Slots of later stage items that take a team from it become open again. That is refused
once such a stage item has results, which belong to the teams that advanced.

get.description: Get the teams of every stage item, best first. Teams advance to the next stage in this order.
The teams that take part, with their lineups and their results in the tournament.

parameters.description: Max number of results in a single page.
parameters.name: limit

schema.title: Limit

parameters.description: Filter results starting from this offset.
parameters.name: offset

schema.description: Filter results starting from this offset.
schema.title: Offset

post.description:
Let these teams take part. Their active members join the tournament's lineup, unless one of
them already plays for another of its teams.

delete.description: The team leaves the tournament. One that has a slot in a stage can't.

post.description:
Create teams from a list and let them take part. A player whose name is already taken,
regardless of case, joins as that player.

get.description:
Everything the organizers' pages of a tournament show, in one answer from one snapshot: the
stages with their draft rounds, players, teams, rankings, standings, what the stages' slots
can take and who would advance into the next stage.

put.description:
Asks for the current password as well, so that a stolen session can't lock the owner out.

Signs out every other session. This one gets a new session cookie.
